outputs.explanation: The caption clarifies that the 7–11 quantified regions per group were all drawn from only 2 mice total, explicitly labeled as the biological replicate unit. Since a one-way ANOVA and summary statistics (mean with 95% CI) are presented, but the true biological replicate number is only 2, this falls at or below the minimum threshold of >2 required for statistical summaries, indicating a pseudoreplication issue in replicate reporting.
